senses.definition: n.[m.] dominion, ruler (late);—abs. מ׳ Dn 11:3, 5; pl. הַמִּמְשָׁלִים 1 Ch 26:6;—
מ׳ רב great dominion Dn 11:3 (acc. cogn. c. מָשַׁל), v 5 (pred. of מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ).
abstr. for concr. (pl.) = rulers 1 Ch 26:6 (? read הַמּשְׁלִים).
